title: Interview Recall Deck
user: A job seeker with ADHD who needs a low-pressure, repeatable way to prepare and retrieve their own experience examples under interview stress.
smallest_useful_product: An offline PWA that turns a user's own projects into short prompt/evidence cards, supports a timed but pausable voice-or-text rehearsal, and surfaces a one-page pre-interview recall sheet.
success_measure: After seven days, at least 60% of pilot users can recall three concrete examples for each chosen competency without consulting full notes.
constraints: Local-first encrypted export; explicitly label any optional drafting aid as user-edited; no mental-health claims; accessibility includes keyboard, TTS and reduced-motion controls.
